node.statement: For fixed n, the amplification map iota_n: B(A) -> B(M_n(A)), iota_n(S)=1_{M_n} tensor S, is bounded. Indeed, realize the operator space A concretely and write X=[x_ij] in M_n(A). Each coordinate compression has norm at most one, so ||x_ij|| <= ||X||. Hence ||[S(x_ij)]|| <= sum_{i,j} ||S(x_ij)|| <= n^2 ||S|| ||X||, where the first inequality follows by writing [S(x_ij)] as the finite sum of its matrix-entry operators. Thus ||iota_n(S)|| <= n^2 ||S||, and iota_n is continuous linear.
